slides.title: Where expertise becomes opportunity
slides.lead: Helping polygraph professionals grow, build reputation, expand their network, and unlock new opportunities.
slides.footer: A global ecosystem for polygraph professionals
slides.note: We succeed when our professionals get tangible value. This is a stakeholder vision, not a validated fundraising pitch. Detelgy enables opportunities; it does not guarantee clients, income, professional standing or improved examination accuracy. Original promise: Helping polygraph professionals grow their expertise, reputation, connections and income opportunities.

slides.title:
A global profession.
Still disconnected.
slides.lead: Profiles, clients, peers, and learning still live in separate places.
slides.footer: Working hypothesis · sources in speaker notes
slides.note: The APA provides a professional directory and educational seminars, demonstrating existing channels. The broader fragmentation framing is a hypothesis from the supplied briefs, not a measured industry-wide finding. No market size is asserted. Four visual fragments group the existing channels: visibility (websites, directories and social), clients (referrals), peers (messaging groups and associations), and learning (seminars). Existing networks already provide value. Working hypothesis · sources in speaker notes. Validate the fragmentation framing through expert discovery and market learning.
sources: American Polygraph Association: prospective member resources and seminars. Accessed 15 October 2026. https://www.polygraph.org/for_prospective_members.php
slides.prompt: What if expertise could move between them?
slides.diagramAlt: A prominent professional sits between four separate worlds: Visibility, Clients, Peers and Learning. Interrupted connections illustrate fragmentation.

slides.footer: Strategic audience hypotheses · initial country focus: Ukraine and Spain
slides.note: These are behavioral archetypes, not demographic segments. Commercially active independent examiners are the initial ICP hypothesis. Institutional examiners may have restrictions on commercial work. Prioritize useful local density over claims of global marketplace liquidity. Strategic audience hypotheses · initial country focus: Ukraine and Spain. These are complementary audiences, not Basic / Specialist / Master levels or a fixed progression. The independent examiner is the primary ICP; emerging professionals and established experts create value alongside them. Portraits are AI-generated illustrative characters, not actual members or demographic definitions.
sources: ICP / Personas §§2–7; Product brief §§4, 9; Investor story S03.

slides.title: From joining to growing.
slides.lead: The first valuable moment is different for every professional.
slides.footer: Illustrative, non-linear journey · first-value moments are hypotheses
slides.note: Participation can create professional value without a paid transaction. Journeys may start at different points, loop or branch. A profile view is not a qualified lead, and activity is not proof of career improvement. Full underlying journey: Discover → Join → Participate → Connect & learn → Build reputation → Find opportunities → Earn / lead → Refer & contribute. The five visual milestones group this eight-step model; the route is illustrative, not a growth metric. Illustrative, non-linear journey · first-value moments are hypotheses.
slides.diagramAlt: A rising curved route links Discover, Join, Connect, Build reputation and Grow. Connect is the focal stage.

slides.title:
Every meaningful contribution
can create more value
slides.lead: Useful knowledge can build visibility and trust. Relevant opportunities can give people a reason to return.
slides.footer: Proposed mechanism · not a demonstrated network effect
slides.note: Every arrow is a hypothesis to measure. There is no guarantee that contributing increases orders. Test contribution-to-profile discovery, relevant relationships, attributed inquiries and repeat meaningful participation. Proposed mechanism · not a demonstrated network effect.

slides.title:
Professional success
has more than one path
slides.lead: A stronger practice. A wider impact. A lasting contribution.
slides.footer: Complementary paths, not ranks · some mechanisms are planned
slides.note: Industry Leader recognition is distinct from transaction-based levels and does not automatically confer Master status. Professionals can follow more than one path. Teaching and paid peer consulting belong to phased expansion. Complementary paths, not ranks · some mechanisms are planned.
sources: Product brief §§7, 11; ICP / Personas §12; Investor story S12.

slides.title:

slides.note: Free, Plus and Pro are proposed memberships. The product brief includes draft prices, intentionally omitted here to avoid public commitments. Proposed commercial model · pricing, payment operations and demand require validation.
